name: Захист від подвійного нападу
description:
In several lessons we learned about the double attack. A double attack occurs when two pieces are attacked at the same time!

There are several ways to defend against a double attack. The following methods can be effective against a double attack:

  • interposing
  • capturing the attacker
  • counter attacking 
  • Protecting your pieces

What do you have to do?

Try to defend against the double attack.

examples.text: Black has a vicious double attack, but with a smart defensive move White can save both pieces.
The rook and king are both under attack. Yet this is not a problem because white can save the rook by placing the rook in between the king and enemy queen.
